messages:
mike: Hey team — PR #9112 is blocked by a flaky smoke test on the sharder shard. CI timed out on step `sharder-smoke` twice. Can someone take a quick look? Need to merge a small hotfix. /cc @jen @sanjay

devops-bot: Buildkite failure on pipeline `redwood/sharder-e2e` — job 5478 — step `sharder-smoke` timed out after 10m. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] ERROR: sharder-smoke exceeded 600s
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/sharder_smoke.py", line 87, in <module>
    run_smoke()
TimeoutError: step exceeded
```
Retry suggested: `bk restart 5478` :arrows_counterclockwise: 

sanjay: I can try a rerun but if it's flaky we should bisect. Is there a reproducible seed? Any recent changes to batch-scheduler?

mike: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9112 — adds guard in shard allocator (small change). Commit 5c8f2a1. No batch-scheduler edits AFAIK.

jen: I'll take a look now, can repro locally? If not, I'll rerun CI. ping me in 20m if I don't update. :eyes: 

elaine: fwiw I saw a similar timeout yesterday on canary, likely infra contention on the sharder vm. If rerun, try `--shard-count=2` variant so steps are faster.

devops-bot: Rerun triggered by @jen — job 5479 started. Keep an eye: `bk logs 5479 --step sharder-smoke`

alicia: I saw the test hang on the same socket close call before. Quick patch: add a 30s deadline around the socket wait. I can open a follow-up PR if this run passes.

jen: rerun came back green for sharder-smoke, other steps passed. Going to approve and merge unless anyone objects.

mike: thanks @jen and @alicia — please merge when ready. Marking this for hotfix deploy today. :rocket:

sanjay: thanks all — follow-up PR for socket deadline sounds good. I'll add an xfail entry if we hit more flakes.
